[[Gift of Research]] is a [[legendary]] crafting component used for [[crafting]] generation 3 [[legendary weapon]]s, legendary [[Obsidian armor]], [[Klobjarne Geirr]], [[Aetheric Anchor]], [[Selachimorpha]], [[Stella Radians]], and the [[legendary relic]]. It is [[Inventory#Stacking|stackable]].
